name: Technical University of Munich
notes: IELTS applies only to TUM's English-taught degree programmes; German-taught degrees want TestDaF or DSH instead and IELTS will not substitute. The English-taught bar is 6.5 overall with no per-skill floor published. Certificates must be under two years old.

name: Karlsruhe Institute of Technology (KIT)
notes: Applies to KIT's English-taught master's programmes (Computer Science, Mechanical Engineering, Electrical Engineering and others): IELTS Academic 6.5 with no section below 5.5. German-taught degrees follow a separate German-language requirement and are not covered here.
